name: moflow
description:
Net worth tracker: all your assets in one place. Ask ChatGPT what you're worth and how it's changed, or tell it what to update.

Moflow is a net worth tracker: all your assets in one place. What you own and what you owe, across 38 currencies, add up to one net worth. Each month, a snapshot records your balances and builds your history.

Moflow also connects your brokerage accounts and prices your holdings where supported, updates them once a day, and records your net worth every day, even when the app is closed.

Connect Moflow to ChatGPT and ask in plain words: “What's my net worth right now?” or “How has my net worth changed over the last six months?” ChatGPT can read your net worth and what it's made of; your accounts and balances, in their own currency and in yours; your holdings with their prices, cost and lots; and your transfers, goals, target mix, income, monthly burn, snapshots and trends.

Tell ChatGPT what changed and it updates Moflow for you: it sets a balance, adds or edits an account, records a holding you bought or sold, or a transfer between your accounts, sets your goals, target mix, income and burn, and closes the month with a snapshot. If a change breaks a rule, nothing is saved.

Moflow only reads from your brokerage accounts. It never trades, never places orders and never moves money at a bank or broker; its tools change your data in Moflow only. Moflow gives no investment advice.

Moflow's copy of your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and used to serve you. The tools work on a Moflow+ account.

defaultPrompt: What's my net worth right now?
Which of my accounts are in foreign currencies, and what are they worth in my home currency?
How has my net worth changed over the last six months?

positive.description: Net worth now. The ledger's master currency is USD.
positive.prompt: What's my net worth right now?
positive.expected_behavior: One net-worth total in USD, with the parts it adds up from: settled and in transit, and the assets by class (Equities, Cash & Equivalents, Fixed Income, Crypto). It may call get_plan first.

positive.description: Balances across currencies, each converted to the master currency (USD).
positive.prompt: Which of my accounts hold euros or pounds, and what are they worth in US dollars?
positive.expected_behavior: Tuscany summers at €9,640 and Edinburgh trips at £5,100, each with its value in USD.

positive.description: The confirmed monthly history. The account holds twelve confirmed months ending the month before last; last month waits for the member to confirm it.
positive.prompt: How has my net worth changed over the last six months?
positive.expected_behavior: Six confirmed months, each with its net worth and its change from the month before.

positive.description: The holdings in one investment account.
positive.prompt: What do I hold in Theo's sabbatical, and what is it worth?
positive.expected_behavior: Each holding in Theo's sabbatical with its quantity, average cost, price, market value and unrealized profit, plus the account's total value. get_balances may stand in for list_accounts to find the account.

positive.description: A write the member asks for: set one cash balance. The tool is marked destructive, so ChatGPT asks to confirm first.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks to confirm. After confirming, the answer gives the previous balance of 18,200 USD, the new balance of 20,000 USD, and the net worth that follows.

negative.description: Placing a trade. Moflow records what the member already did at their broker and never trades, and no tool can place an order. Expected: no write; the assistant says Moflow cannot place trades.
negative.prompt: Buy 10 shares of Apple in Theo's sabbatical.

negative.description: A transfer between accounts in two currencies. Transfers in Moflow are same-currency ledger records and move no money. Expected: record_transfer answers write_rejected with reason cross_currency, and nothing is stored.
negative.prompt: Transfer 500 from Canada visits to Day-to-day.

negative.description: Investment advice. Moflow gives none. Expected: Moflow is not called, or is read only for context; no recommendation comes from Moflow.
negative.prompt: Which stock should I buy next?

publication.release_notes: First release. Moflow is a net-worth ledger: accounts, balances, holdings and confirmed monthly history across currencies. The plugin reads the member's own ledger and, when asked, records balances, accounts, holdings and month-end confirmations. It never trades or moves money.
